ROW.COLUMN: (ML/AC) Anomalies in ATM, Bank Card: Excessive Withdrawals

Bank cards can be easily used at Automated Teller Machine (ATM) to transfer assets to other individuals or locations due to the anonymity they afford the users. Deposits can be made into accounts in any number of ways and then be removed as currency from almost any location. A sudden increase in the number or amount of ATM deposits and withdrawals may indicate an attempt to launder funds; an increase in ATM withdrawals, or change in the location of ATMs used may also indicate account takeover. Sudden increases in the activity at a certain location may indicate fraudsters' use of skimmed or compromised bank cards. This scenario monitors a sudden increase in the amount of bank card withdrawals at ATMs that may indicate money laundering, terrorist financing, or an account takeover.

All scenario logic is implemented at primary rule dataset level. First sub-rule is for retrieving Related Excessive Withdrawals and second is for Account Balance building block. Other building blocks are created by match augmentation window.

SELECT a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, b.ACCT_INTRL_ID, a.HH_ACCT_GRP_ID, c.NVSMT_MGR_SEQ_ID FROM @MINER@.NVSMT_MGR c inner join @MINER@.MANGD_ACCT b inner join @MINER@.ACCT a on (b.ACCT_INTRL_ID=a.ACCT_INTRL_ID) on (c.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID=b.NVSMT_MGR_INTRL_ID)

--sagafono 06/03/2018 Bug#27482104 with Curr_Date_Trxn as -- Get all the distinct accounts-transactions pair submitted for the current processing day (exectn date within max days to cover) and satisfying Min ATM Loc Ct ( select DISTINCT CT.ACCT_INTRL_ID, A.ACCT_SEQ_ID, A.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB, A.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID, ( Select (Case when UPPER(@Day_Type) = 'BUS' THEN KC1.BUS_DAY_AGE ELSE KC1.CLNDR_DAY_AGE End) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC1 Where KC1.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' And KC1.CLNDR_DT = CT.TRXN_EXCTN_DT ) AS Day_no from @MINER@.CASH_TRXN CT inner join @MINER@.ACCT A on CT.ACCT_INTRL_ID = A.ACCT_INTRL_ID where -- Include ATM Withdrawal Transactions Only CT.DBT_CDT_CD='D' and CT.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_CD = 'ATM' -- PR31162 and CT.MANTAS_TRXN_ASSET_CLASS_CD = 'FUNDS' -- Include customer retail accounts only and A.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD = 'CR' -- Exclude exempted accounts and A.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 -- Exclude distribution, dividend, fee, interest, and transfer-of-account transactions and CT.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' -- Oracle business acct type and A.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD in (@Mantas_Bus_Acct_Type_Lst) --Included Trans Source Codes and (@All_Trans_Src_Fl = 'Y' or CT.SRC_SYS_CD in (@Incl_Trans_Src_Lst)) --All Jurisdictions/Included Jurisdictions and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' or A.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst)) --To get all the transactions on processing date --To get all the transactions on today's processing date and CT.DATA_DUMP_DT in ( select KC2.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC2 where KC2.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and (Case when UPPER(@Day_Type) = 'BUS' THEN KC2.BUS_DAY_AGE ELSE KC2.CLNDR_DAY_AGE End) = 0 ) -- The maximum number of prior days to look for AND CT.TRXN_EXCTN_DT > ( select max(KC3.CLNDR_DT) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC3 where KC3.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and (Case when UPPER(@Day_Type) = 'BUS' THEN KC3.BUS_DAY_AGE ELSE KC3.CLNDR_DAY_AGE End) = @Max_Days_To_Cover ) ),
-- Inserts dummy previous execution dates which are not dumped today, but required for calculations Comb_Date_Trxn as ( select distinct T.ACCT_INTRL_ID, T.Day_no, T.ACCT_SEQ_ID, T.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB, T.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID from Curr_Date_Trxn T
UNION
select T.ACCT_INTRL_ID, T.Day_no+1, T.ACCT_SEQ_ID, T.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB, T.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID from Curr_Date_Trxn T ),
-- Calculates Two Day Avg for the dates retrieved from above combined dates Two_Day_Avg as ( select All_trxn.*, (sum(All_trxn.TRXN_BASE_AM) OVER (partition by All_trxn.ACCT_INTRL_ID order by All_trxn.Day_no desc rows 1 PRECEDING) / sum(All_trxn.TRXN_DAY_CT) OVER (partition by All_trxn.ACCT_INTRL_ID order by All_trxn.Day_no desc rows 1 PRECEDING)) as TWO_DAY_AVG_AMT from ( -- inserts dummy records with the prev dates for which no trxn occurs along with summation of trxns occuring, but required for calcuations Select CDT.ACCT_INTRL_ID, CDT.Day_no, Sum_trxn.ACCT_SEQ_ID, Sum_trxn.TRXN_BASE_AM, Sum_trxn.TRXN_DAY_CT, Sum_trxn.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB, Sum_trxn.ACTVTY_RISK_LVL, Sum_trxn.LRF_TRANS_AMT, Sum_trxn.HRF_TRANS_AMT, Sum_trxn.OVERALL_RISK, Sum_trxn.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID from ( -- retrieves & sum up (per day) all the ATM debit trxns for all the combined dates found select CDT.ACCT_INTRL_ID, CDT.Day_no, 1 as TRXN_DAY_CT, max(CDT.ACCT_SEQ_ID) as ACCT_SEQ_ID, sum(CT.TRXN_BASE_AM) TRXN_BASE_AM, max(CDT.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB) as ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB, max(CT.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB) as ACTVTY_RISK_LVL, sum(case when (CT.TRXN_BASE_AM - TRUNC(CT.TRXN_BASE_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0 or CT.TRXN_ACTVY_AM - TRUNC(CT.TRXN_ACTVY_AM, -@Lrf_Digits) = 0) then CT.TRXN_BASE_AM else 0 end ) as LRF_TRANS_AMT, sum(case when CT.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB > @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl then CT.TRXN_BASE_AM else 0 end ) as HRF_TRANS_AMT , (case when max(CDT.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB)>= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl and max(CT.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB) >= @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl then 'HR' when max(CDT.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB)< @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl and max(CT.CASH_TRXN_ACTVY_RISK_NB) < @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl then 'RR' else 'MR' end ) as OVERALL_RISK, max(CDT.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID) as PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID from @MINER@.CASH_TRXN CT INNER JOIN Comb_Date_Trxn CDT ON CDT.ACCT_INTRL_ID = CT.ACCT_INTRL_ID where -- Include ATM Withdrawal Transactions Only CT.DBT_CDT_CD='D' and CT.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_CD = 'ATM' -- PR31162 and CT.MANTAS_TRXN_ASSET_CLASS_CD = 'FUNDS' -- Exclude distribution, dividend, fee, interest, and transfer-of-account transactions and CT.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' --Included Trans Source Codes and (@All_Trans_Src_Fl = 'Y' or CT.SRC_SYS_CD in (@Incl_Trans_Src_Lst)) and CT.TRXN_EXCTN_DT in ( Select KC4.CLNDR_DT From @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC4 Where CDT.Day_no = (case when UPPER(@Day_Type) = 'BUS' THEN KC4.BUS_DAY_AGE ELSE KC4.CLNDR_DAY_AGE End) And KC4.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' ) group by CDT.ACCT_INTRL_ID, CDT.Day_no ) Sum_trxn RIGHT OUTER JOIN Comb_Date_Trxn CDT ON CDT.ACCT_INTRL_ID = Sum_trxn.ACCT_INTRL_ID and CDT.Day_no = Sum_trxn.Day_no ) All_trxn ),
-- Calculates Historical Avg (daily) for Acct-Execution date pair over lookback period (rolling 3 months) Hist_Dly_Avg as ( select CDT.ACCT_INTRL_ID, CDT.Day_no, sum(AASD.ATM_TRXN_OUT_CT) AS ATM_TRXN_OUT_CT, sum(AASD.ATM_TRXN_OUT_AM) AS ATM_TRXN_OUT_AM, sum( case when AASD.ATM_TRXN_OUT_AM > 0 then 1 else 0 end ) as ACTIVE_DAY_COUNT, -- Average Amount of ATM Withdrawals within the Lookback Period) --Bug#27482104 -- sum(AASD.ATM_TRXN_OUT_AM) / sum(case when AASD.ATM_TRXN_OUT_AM > 0 then 1 else 0 end) HIST_DAILY_AVG_AMT case when sum(case when AASD.ATM_TRXN_OUT_AM > 0 then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then sum(AASD.ATM_TRXN_OUT_AM) / sum(case when AASD.ATM_TRXN_OUT_AM > 0 then 1 else 0 end) else 0 end as HIST_DAILY_AVG_AMT
from @MINER@.ACCT_ATM_SMRY_DAILY AASD inner join Curr_Date_Trxn CDT on CDT.ACCT_INTRL_ID = AASD.ACCT_INTRL_ID --The Lookback Period will vary depending on the transaction dates in the current processing batch. It is the number of days which equals --The total days in the specified months for the Lookback Period plus The total days in the Current Month up to the day before the Previous Day. where AASD.EXCTN_DT < ( Select min(KC5.CLNDR_DT) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC5 Where KC5.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and ((case when UPPER(@Day_Type) = 'BUS' THEN KC5.BUS_DAY_AGE ELSE KC5.CLNDR_DAY_AGE End) = (CDT.Day_no+1) ) ) and AASD.EXCTN_DT >= ADD_MONTHS(F_TRUNC_DATE(( Select min(KC6.CLNDR_DT) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC6 Where KC6.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and ((case when UPPER(@Day_Type) = 'BUS' THEN KC6.BUS_DAY_AGE ELSE KC6.CLNDR_DAY_AGE End) = (CDT.Day_no+1) ) ), 'MM'), -@Look_Back_Period) group by CDT.ACCT_INTRL_ID, CDT.Day_no having sum(AASD.ATM_TRXN_OUT_CT) > 0 )
-- Final Alert generation logic to find pctg incr of 2 day avg over hist avg select TDA.ACCT_INTRL_ID, TDA.ACCT_SEQ_ID, ( Select min(KC7.CLNDR_DT) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC7 Where KC7.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and ((case when UPPER(@Day_Type) = 'BUS' THEN KC7.BUS_DAY_AGE ELSE KC7.CLNDR_DAY_AGE End) = CDT.Day_no ) ) as TRXN_EXCTN_DT, CDT.Day_no, TDA.TWO_DAY_AVG_AMT, coalesce(HDA.HIST_DAILY_AVG_AMT,0) as HIST_DAILY_AVG_AMT, --Percentage increase of the two day daily average ATM withdrawals amount from the historical daily average ATM withdrawals amount . ( case when (HDA.HIST_DAILY_AVG_AMT is not null) and HDA.HIST_DAILY_AVG_AMT > 0 --Bug#27482104 then ( ( (TDA.TWO_DAY_AVG_AMT - HDA.HIST_DAILY_AVG_AMT) / HDA.HIST_DAILY_AVG_AMT ) * 100 ) else 9999999 -- default value end ) as PCT_AVG_AMT_INCR, TDA.OVERALL_RISK, TDA.ACCT_EFCTV_RISK_NB, TDA.ACTVTY_RISK_LVL, case when TDA.TRXN_BASE_AM=0 then 0 else TDA.HRF_TRANS_AMT / TDA.TRXN_BASE_AM * 100 end as HR_PRCTG, case when TDA.TRXN_BASE_AM=0 then 0 else TDA.LRF_TRANS_AMT / TDA.TRXN_BASE_AM * 100 end as LRF_PRCTG, TDA.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID from Two_Day_Avg TDA left outer join Hist_Dly_Avg HDA on TDA.ACCT_INTRL_ID = HDA.ACCT_INTRL_ID and TDA.Day_no = HDA.Day_no inner join Curr_Date_Trxn CDT on TDA.ACCT_INTRL_ID = CDT.ACCT_INTRL_ID and TDA.Day_no = CDT.Day_no --Bug#19903192 -- CLONE 6.2.1 ANOM ATM/BC - EXCESSIVE WD CU FOCUS where ( TDA.OVERALL_RISK = 'HR' and TDA.TWO_DAY_AVG_AMT >= @HR_Min_Daily_Average_ATM_WD_Amt and (case when (HDA.HIST_DAILY_AVG_AMT is not null) and HDA.HIST_DAILY_AVG_AMT > 0 --Bug#27482104 then ( ( (TDA.TWO_DAY_AVG_AMT - HDA.HIST_DAILY_AVG_AMT) / HDA.HIST_DAILY_AVG_AMT ) * 100 ) else 9999999 -- default value end) >= @HR_Pct_Daily_ATM_WD_Amt_Increase ) or ( TDA.OVERALL_RISK = 'MR' and TDA.TWO_DAY_AVG_AMT >= @MR_Min_Daily_Average_ATM_WD_Amt and (case when (HDA.HIST_DAILY_AVG_AMT is not null) and HDA.HIST_DAILY_AVG_AMT > 0 --Bug#27482104 then ( ( (TDA.TWO_DAY_AVG_AMT - HDA.HIST_DAILY_AVG_AMT) / HDA.HIST_DAILY_AVG_AMT ) * 100 ) else 9999999 -- default value end) >= @MR_Pct_Daily_ATM_WD_Amt_Increase ) or ( TDA.OVERALL_RISK = 'RR' and TDA.TWO_DAY_AVG_AMT >= @RR_Min_Daily_Average_ATM_WD_Amt and (case when (HDA.HIST_DAILY_AVG_AMT is not null) and HDA.HIST_DAILY_AVG_AMT > 0 --Bug#27482104 then ( ( (TDA.TWO_DAY_AVG_AMT - HDA.HIST_DAILY_AVG_AMT) / HDA.HIST_DAILY_AVG_AMT ) * 100 ) else 9999999 -- default value end) >= @RR_Pct_Daily_ATM_WD_Amt_Increase )

select distinct CT.ACCT_INTRL_ID, CT.FO_TRXN_SEQ_ID, PRIM.Day_no, count (distinct CT.TRXN_LOC_ID) over (partition by PRIM.ACCT_INTRL_ID, PRIM.Day_no) as LOC_CNT from @MINER@.CASH_TRXN CT inner join @MINER@.DSVIEW114016001 PRIM on PRIM.ACCT_INTRL_ID=CT.ACCT_INTRL_ID where -- Include ATM Withdrawal/Outgoing/Debit Transactions Only CT.DBT_CDT_CD='D' and CT.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_CD = 'ATM' and CT.MANTAS_TRXN_ASSET_CLASS_CD = 'FUNDS' -- Exclude Distribution, Dividend, Fee, Interest, and Transfer-Of-Account Transactions and CT.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' --Included Trans Source Codes and (@All_Trans_Src_Fl='Y' or CT.SRC_SYS_CD in (@Incl_Trans_Src_Lst)) and CT.TRXN_EXCTN_DT between ( Select min(KC1.CLNDR_DT) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC1 Where KC1.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and ((case when UPPER(@Day_Type) = 'BUS' THEN KC1.BUS_DAY_AGE ELSE KC1.CLNDR_DAY_AGE End) = PRIM.Day_no+1 ) ) and ( Select max(KC2.CLNDR_DT) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC2 Where KC2.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and ((case when UPPER(@Day_Type) = 'BUS' THEN KC2.BUS_DAY_AGE ELSE KC2.CLNDR_DAY_AGE End) = PRIM.Day_no ) )

Select prim.ACCT_INTRL_ID, ab.ACCT_BAL_SEQ_ID From @MINER@.DSVIEW114016001 prim inner join @MINER@.ACCT_BAL_POSN_SMRY ab on (prim.ACCT_INTRL_ID = ab.ACCT_INTRL_ID) where ab.DATA_DUMP_DT = ( select min(KC.CLNDR_DT) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC where KC.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and (Case when UPPER(@Day_Type) = 'BUS' THEN KC.BUS_DAY_AGE ELSE KC.CLNDR_DAY_AGE End) = 0 )

select distinct AASD.ACCT_ATM_SMRY_SEQ_ID, AASD.ACCT_INTRL_ID, PRIM.Day_no from @MINER@.ACCT_ATM_SMRY_DAILY AASD inner join @MINER@.DSVIEW114016001 PRIM on PRIM.ACCT_INTRL_ID = AASD.ACCT_INTRL_ID where AASD.EXCTN_DT between ADD_MONTHS(F_TRUNC_DATE(( Select min(KC1.CLNDR_DT) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC1 Where KC1.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and ((case when UPPER(@Day_Type) = 'BUS' THEN KC1.BUS_DAY_AGE ELSE KC1.CLNDR_DAY_AGE End) = (PRIM.Day_no+1) ) ), 'MM'), -@Look_Back_Period) AND ( Select max(KC2.CLNDR_DT) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL KC2 Where KC2.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and ((case when UPPER(@Day_Type) = 'BUS' THEN KC2.BUS_DAY_AGE ELSE KC2.CLNDR_DAY_AGE End) = PRIM.Day_no+2 ) )
